title: Squared+
description: A resourcepack making most GUI more square
body:
![Squared+](https://utils.notionsmp.org/pph/?text=%20%20Squared%20Plus%20%20&color=0xFF66BB&size=20)
---
**Squared+** aims to make the GUIs in minecraft more square, mostly just the round edges of containers, but also small things like bossbar borders, and the blaze powder indicator in the brewing stand.

Changes include but are not limited to:

---
**🐲 Bossbars**
- Sharper edges

![Bossbars](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ef49e610640468cb15298ae70041e21ba64feb3f.png)
---
**ℹ️ Tooltips**
- Sharper frame
- Sharper background edges

![Item Tooltip](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4862c83ec33505d263498a2fdb132ed291d6d69c.png)
---
**🎖 Advancements**
- Sharper popup edges
- Description tooltips
- Advancement frames

![Advancement Menu and Tooltip](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/578683f2ecba1b9d801371659a2a907633baa0b4.png)
![Advancement Popups](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/38ebf6dc66195c33b25a2d551beceddf05aa6a6a.png)
---
**📦 Inventories**
- Sharper edges
- Tabs

![Creative Inventory](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eb88e9745e3716d8073f31349da15fdccd3a58fd.png)
---
